searchText: How can SSZ be 50% less in size for relatively large transactions? SSZ is typically "Snappy framed" compressed, on the network and in the database. It is a compression that is designed to be fast, and it tends to work quite well with practical use cases. I suspect that the large number of zero bytes in real transactions in `access_list` and `input` fields are the ones pushing this in favor of SSZ. SSZ `PartialContainer` spec: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/7495
